svg.title: How diagramify works
svg.desc: How diagramify works. 15 components in 4 groups. Connections: Agent or editor to diagram.yaml (writes); diagram.yaml to Validate; Validate to ELK layout; ELK layout to Render; AWS to Render; Azure to Render; Google Cloud to Render; Kubernetes to Render; GitHub and logos to Render; Render to SVG; Render to PNG; Render to draw.io; Render to React TSX; Render to HTML viewer.

text.tspan: One YAML spec in, five formats out, with official icons and automatic layout
